# ESO Auditors & Consultants

> A full-service audit, tax, accounting and corporate advisory firm based in Jal El Dib, Metn, Lebanon, serving enterprises across Lebanon and the MENA region to Big 4 standards since 2001. Member of the Lebanese Association of Certified Public Accountants (LACPA). Founder & CEO: Elie Salloum.

Contact: info@eso-acc.com · +961 4 725 730 · Jal El Dib, Metn, Lebanon (P.O. Box 60-468)
Languages: English, Arabic, French

## Core services
- [Audit & Assurance](https://eso-website.vercel.app/service-audit): Statutory and independent audits under ISA, IFRS compliance and transition, internal control reviews, agreed-upon procedures.
- [Tax Advisory](https://eso-website.vercel.app/service-tax): Corporate tax planning, VAT compliance, Ministry of Finance decree guidance, tax audit defense.
- [Accounting](https://eso-website.vercel.app/service-accounting): Bookkeeping, NSSF payroll, multi-currency reconciliation, management reporting.
- [Corporate Consulting](https://eso-website.vercel.app/service-consulting): M&A due diligence, enterprise valuation, outsourced CFO, operational restructuring.

## Specialization
- [Food & Beverage](https://eso-website.vercel.app/client-fb): Roughly 70% of ESO's enterprise clients are in F&B. Depth in restaurant prime-cost control, POS and delivery-aggregator reconciliation, franchise and multi-unit royalty audits, and NSSF payroll for hospitality.

## Lebanon regulatory resources
- [Market Guide](https://eso-website.vercel.app/lebanon-guide): Operating in Lebanon — MoF decrees, NSSF, cross-border structuring.
- [Ministry of Finance Decrees (Kararat)](https://eso-website.vercel.app/kararat-portal): Curated official Lebanese MoF decrees.
- [Insights & Studies](https://eso-website.vercel.app/news): 22 dated technical studies (Oct 2024 – Jul 2026) on IFRS 18/19, deposit recovery under the financial-gap framework, NSSF ceilings, e-invoicing, transfer pricing, valuation and audit standards.
